d: Bradley Walsh presents the big money quiz based on his own idea which features six players who cannot leave the contest until somebody wins.

Contestants compete across the series, scoring points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day.
A family from Leeds try to top the tower as they seek a perfect ten and the big prize.
A team of four, work colleagues Renae, Olu, Santana and Mikey, take on the Bridge of Lies. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category.
Bradley Walsh hosts and is behind Pete, Novuyo, Joan and Nik all the way as they try to beat one of the country's finest quiz brains and take home thousands of pounds.
People from across the country are looking to win big money, but they'll have to take down The Beast, The Governess, The Menace, The Vixen and The Dark Destroyer to win it.

t: The Chase: Celebrity Special: For Soccer Aid
d: Celebrities Kirsty Gallacher, Charley Boorman, Clive Tyldesley and Rachel Riley pull their wits together to take down the Chaser and win thousands of pounds for Soccer Aid for UNICEF.
